tools.name: check_hotel_price
tools.description: Say whether a price the person has been quoted for a hotel is high, low or usual for that hotel in that month, using HotelMonitor's own scans. Use it when someone asks "is this a good price?". Returns no verdict when there is not enough data. Prices are tax-inclusive nightly figures for two adults from past scans (the Agoda share is an estimate of tax), not a live quote. Results include page_url (price history). book_url (a booking-site link with the dates filled in) is included only when checkin and checkout dates are given.

destination.description: Destination slug, e.g. tenerife, new-york, algarve.

checkout.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Required when per is "stay". At most 30 nights.

per.description: Is price per night or for the whole stay?

via.description: Optional short name of your app or assistant (lower-case letters, digits, - or _), used in booking links so we can see where visits come from.

children.description: Children in the party. We only judge prices for 2 adults and no children.

taxes.description: Does the quoted price include taxes? Default included.

tools.name: get_destination_prices
tools.description: Typical nightly hotel price by month for a destination over the coming months, and its cheapest months. Months with too few scans are left out. Use it for "when is it cheapest to go to X?". Prices are tax-inclusive nightly figures for two adults from past scans (the Agoda share is an estimate of tax), not a live quote. Results include page_url (price history) and, for each month, book_url (a booking-site search with dates in that month filled in) for checking current prices. Agoda's Mega Sale runs from 16 to 30 November. It is Agoda's own sale and HotelMonitor has not checked Agoda's prices. Details: https://hotelmonitor.co.uk/black-friday-hotel-deals-2026

via.description: Optional short name of your app or assistant (lower-case letters, digits, - or _), used in booking links so we can see where visits come from.

tools.name: find_hotel_deals
tools.description: Current hotel deals from the latest scans (at most 20): hotels priced below their typical level, optionally for one destination, check-in month or maximum nightly price. Prices are tax-inclusive nightly figures for two adults from past scans (the Agoda share is an estimate of tax), not a live quote. Each deal includes page_url (price history) and book_url (a booking-site link with the dates filled in) for checking the current price. Agoda's Mega Sale runs from 16 to 30 November. It is Agoda's own sale and HotelMonitor has not checked Agoda's prices. Details: https://hotelmonitor.co.uk/black-friday-hotel-deals-2026

max_price.description: Maximum price per night in GBP.

via.description: Optional short name of your app or assistant (lower-case letters, digits, - or _), used in booking links so we can see where visits come from.

tools.name: is_this_a_good_price
tools.description: Say whether a quoted hotel price is good, typical or high against HotelMonitor's stored prices for the same hotel, check-in month, nights band, party (2 adults) and tax basis. Returns no verdict when there are fewer than 20 prices over 14 days. Includes a URL to cite.

tools.name: cheapest_time_to_visit
tools.description: Cheapest and dearest months, and cheapest weeks, for a destination from HotelMonitor's stored scans, each with its scan count and dates. Includes a URL to cite.

tools.name: find_trip
tools.description: Shortlist hotels for a destination, check-in window, nights and party, with live prices for a few dates, the tax basis and what could not be confirmed. Capped and cached; anonymous callers get 3 a day.
